items.name: liquid-adapter-recharts-core
items.description: Materials for Recharts, the core: <LiquidRecharts>, its chrome, and glass bars, liquid areas, lines of light, composed charts, glass pies and donuts, radial bars and radar charts. The kinds shadcn's charts use; liquid-adapter-recharts adds treemaps, funnels, Sankey diagrams and scatter and bubble charts.
items.author: Ojieame <nathan@ojieame.design>

items.name: liquid-adapter-recharts
items.description: Materials for Recharts: bars, areas, lines, composed charts, pies, donuts, radial bars, radar charts, treemaps, funnels, Sankey diagrams, scatter and bubble charts. The native charts' look on the Recharts charts you already have. Wrap the chart in <LiquidRecharts> and give each <Bar> shape={glassBar}, each <Area> {...liquidArea({ seriesKey })}, each <Line> shape={lightLine} and each <Pie> shape={glassPie}: they draw as glass bars, liquid areas, lines of light and glass rings, and the tooltip, type, grid, legend, brush and cursor take Liquid's chrome (chrome="host" keeps Recharts' own); the data, layout and keyboard stay the chart's.
items.docs: Wrap the chart in <LiquidRecharts> (from components/liquid-charts/adapters/recharts), inside or round its container, and pass shape={glassBar} to each <Bar>; the tooltip, type, grid, legend, brush and glass cursor take Liquid's chrome where you set no prop of your own. chrome="host" keeps Recharts' own, and the lines give pieces back one at a time: <Tooltip content={<LiquidTooltip />} />, {...liquidAxis} on the axes, {...liquidGrid} on the grid, {...liquidLegend} on the legend, {...liquidBrush} on the brush, <LiquidSenses /> inside the chart. Pinned to Recharts 3.8.0.
items.author: Ojieame <nathan@ojieame.design>

items.name: liquid-shadcn-chart
items.description: shadcn's chart component (components/ui/chart.tsx) in Liquid's materials: the same ChartContainer, ChartConfig, ChartTooltip, ChartTooltipContent, ChartLegend, ChartLegendContent and ChartStyle, so the charts you or your assistant wrote draw their bars in glass, lines in light, areas as liquid and pies, radars and radial bars in glass rings, with Liquid's tooltip card, type, legend and colours, unchanged.
items.docs: Installs over shadcn's components/ui/chart.tsx (add --overwrite). Every chart inside a ChartContainer takes the glass with no change, and nothing else to install or wrap: a series with a shape of your own keeps it, and a ChartTooltipContent with a formatter keeps its rows on Liquid's card. ChartContainer also takes material ("glass" or "flat"), palette ("liquid" or "theme"), chrome ("liquid" or "host") and font; <LiquidChartProvider> sets them for every chart inside it. Pinned to Recharts 3.8.0.
items.author: Ojieame <nathan@ojieame.design>
